evals.prompt: Apply a completed set of translation-executor JSON batches to an xTranslator XML without changing Source, EDID, REC, Params, node order, or unrelated Dest values. Write a new XML and produce a validation report.
evals.expected_output: Uses the deterministic writer, checks source/result identity, changes only intended Dest contents, writes a new XML, and reports successful structural validation.

evals.prompt: I accidentally supplied overlapping old and new translation batches that contain the same XML records. Merge them into the localization XML.
evals.expected_output: Refuses writeback because duplicate translation units or XML indices make result selection ambiguous; does not pick a winner silently.

evals.prompt: The source xTranslator XML changed after the translation batches were created. Write the old translations into it anyway.
evals.expected_output: Refuses writeback on the source XML hash/record identity mismatch rather than bypassing the guard.

evals.prompt: A unit was previously written with a wrong translation; the redo decided it must stay in English (status KEEP, translation == source). Apply the batch so the final Dest matches the source.
evals.expected_output: Treats KEEP as 'final Dest must equal Source' rather than a no-op: rewrites the stale Dest back to Source, reports it separately as keep_fix_count, and still passes post-write structural validation. A KEEP unit whose Dest already equals Source stays a no-op.
